name: find_subtypes
description: Find existing location subtypes by optional id, key substrings, and type. Use before creating a subtype that might already exist. An empty result does not mean the subtype cannot exist.

keys.description: Optional key substrings. Matched case-insensitively with OR; each value is a partial key, for example tav matches tavern.

type.description: Optional location type filter, for example structure or room.
